name: actionproof
description: Gives AI agents verifiable, tamper-evident receipts for their actions — attest_action signs a cryptographic receipt for what the agent did (email sent, payment made, form filed), verify_receipt checks it offline, get_identity returns the agent's did:key. Sign locally, verify anywhere, zero backend.
